_doc: Host LiDAR profiles of the evaluation tools (tools/eval, SPDX BSD-3-Clause; AMENDMENTS A76). 'Host' here is the FAST-LIVO2
estimator the GNSS arms sit on: its LiDAR/IMU pair decides the replay config, the bag topics, the bag directory and the
lever arm the scoring uses. (tools/eval/host_profiles.json is something else: machine profiles.)
config / replay_launch: files of the repository the replay loads (launch/<replay_launch> loads config/<config>; an arm overlay
from config/arms/ is loaded after it by run_matrix.py's wrapper launch).
lidar_topic / imu_topic: the topics the filtered bag keeps (tools/bag_filter.py --lidar) and the config reads.
bag_dir / staging_dir: where fetch_eval.py writes the filtered bag (+ <seq>.fetch.json, <seq>.fetch/) and unpacks; relative to
the project root. The Avia entry is the pre-A76 layout and never changes; other lidars get their own directories, so a
filtered bag of one lidar is never overwritten by another's.
gt_lever_imu: the ground-truth antenna (C-RTK 2HP) in the host IMU frame, metres. The scoring's 'calibrated-lever point' (A76
decision 2) is p_IMU + R_IMU * gt_lever_imu, with the same SE(3) Umeyama / 0.05 s association / span / mask as e1o.
Avia: the A58 value. x, y are a development-set fit (tools/calib/p4_calib.py frame, median of the per-sequence
fits, x -0.12..-0.21, y -0.01..-0.05 over the sequences; the vertical part is not observable for a ground vehicle and is held at the
9Ps antenna's 0.4006, rounded 0.401), NOT a calibration-table value.
MID-360 (A77): the same procedure on this host's own runs, not the calibration chain's translation. tools/calib/host_gt_lever.py
fit on the MID-360 U trajectories of Grass01 and Grass02 (five seeds each, runs a76-mid-dev-g1u0..4 / g2u0..4, 2026-10-02):
the two horizontal components of the level frame (R_level_from_imu) are fitted jointly with the global SE(3), the vertical one
is held at the chain's value (the antenna's 0.401 over the Avia IMU minus the MID-360 IMU's 0.4307 over it = -0.0297 m), the
median over the seeds of each sequence and then over the two sequences, rounded to 1 mm: (-0.049, -0.152, -0.0297). The
IMU-frame vector is that level vector rotated by R_level_from_imu^T (calibration row avia -> mid360). The chain's own value
(translation included) disagreed with the data by 0.15-0.17 m along the heading (A76 record section six) and is no longer
used. tools/tests/test_calib.py re-derives the numbers from calibration.md and the fitted level components.
R_level_from_imu: rotation (row-major) taking free vectors from the host IMU frame to the 'level' frame = the Avia IMU frame,
whose z axis is vertical for the level ground robot (gravity within 2-3 degrees of +z at the start of Grass01 and Outdoor01).
Identity for Avia; for the MID-360 IMU frame (tilted 31.8 degrees against the vertical) the transpose of calibration.md's
avia -> mid360 rotation. tools/eval/lever_floor.py uses it to turn the IMU-frame lever into the vector the heading rotates.
A80 platforms (tools/datasets; their data live under the second project root /data2/fl2g: run_matrix --root /data2/fl2g with
FL2G_BUILD_ROOT=<main root>; bag_dir is relative to THAT root; there is no fetch_eval path for them, the bags are built by
tools/datasets/{smartpnt,mars}/build_slim.py):
smartpnt_mini: the SmartPNT-MSF mini platform (Velodyne VLP-16 + HGuide I300 IMU, config/smartpnt_mini.yaml). gt_lever_imu: the platform's GNSS
antenna Ant00 (the point the trajectory GT refers to) in the I300 frame (x down, y right, z back) = (-0.118, 0, +0.120) m: the difference of the
`IMU->Secondary Sensor Lever Arms` of ROVE_02/Mini_GroundTruth.ref and I300_GroundTruth.ref ((0, -0.120, +0.118) in the carrier frame x right /
y forward / z up), confirmed by the data to 0.4 mm (tools/datasets/smartpnt/gt_convert.py). R_level_from_imu: I300 -> the level frame with x
forward, y left, z up (the frame of the VLP-16, whose extrinsic is the same permutation): x_level = -z_imu, y_level = -y_imu, z_level = -x_imu.
mars_avia: Livox Avia + its IMU on the MARS-LVIG UAV (config/mars_lvig_gnss.yaml). The ground truth is the DJI M300 RTK antenna, whose lever arm to
the Avia IMU the dataset does not publish: gt_lever_imu is 0 (scoring without a lever; a pipeline-debug sequence, nothing is claimed from it).

avia.label: Livox Avia + Avia IMU (A6; the repository's host until the A76 identification decides)

mid360.label: Livox MID-360 + MID-360 IMU (official M3DGR config; the repository's host from A77)
mid360.gt_lever_source: A77: tools/calib/host_gt_lever.py fit, MID-360 U runs a76-mid-dev-g1u0..4 + g2u0..4 (Grass01, Grass02), 2026-10-02; level-frame (-0.049, -0.152), vertical -0.0297 held from the calibration chain

smartpnt_mini.label: SmartPNT-MSF mini platform: Velodyne VLP-16 + HGuide I300 IMU + MER-131 camera (A80)
smartpnt_mini.gt_lever_source: A80: ROVE_02 (Mini) minus I300 .ref lever arms, (0, -0.120, +0.118) in the carrier frame, rotated into the I300 frame; data agree to 0.4 mm

mars_avia.label: MARS-LVIG UAV: Livox Avia + its IMU + left camera, u-blox F9P (A80, pipeline-debug sequence)
mars_avia.gt_lever_source: none: MARS-LVIG publishes no antenna lever arm; the DJI RTK antenna is taken at the IMU
